rules.name: Immediate Dispute Escalation
rules.statement: Unresolved financial disputes must be escalated to a senior support tier within a maximum allowed duration.
rules.condition: when a dispute is flagged during the settlement cycle
exceptions: complex fraud cases requiring external audit
rules.if_violated: revenue distribution is blocked and regulatory penalties may be applied
rules.rationale: delayed resolution erodes partner trust and triggers regulatory scrutiny

parameters.name: maximum allowed duration
parameters.description: time limit for initial dispute triage

rules.name: Fraud-Induced Settlement Halt
rules.statement: Settlement processing must not proceed for any transaction flagged with high-risk indicators until manual verification is complete.
rules.condition: when a transaction is identified as high-risk
rules.if_violated: revenue leakage occurs and regulatory compliance is breached
rules.rationale: prevents financial loss and ensures regulatory adherence during high-volume cycles

parameters.name: high-risk threshold
parameters.description: criteria defining a transaction as high-risk

rules.name: Dispute-Linked Settlement Hold
rules.statement: Final settlement status must not transition to 'Completed' until the associated dispute ticket is resolved to a final state.
rules.condition: when a Financial Transaction Record has an active dispute
exceptions: disputes resolved via automated refund reversal
rules.if_violated: incorrect funds are distributed leading to reconciliation errors
rules.rationale: ensures financial integrity by preventing premature payouts on contested transactions

parameters.name: final resolution state
parameters.description: status indicating dispute is fully closed

rules.name: Immutable Dispute Audit Trail
rules.statement: Every dispute event and its resolution action must be recorded in an immutable audit trail.
rules.condition: when a dispute is created, modified, or resolved
rules.if_violated: inability to prove compliance during regulatory audits
rules.rationale: provides verifiable evidence of fair dispute handling for regulatory bodies

parameters.name: retention period
parameters.description: duration for keeping immutable audit logs
